hero.subtitle: HyperTube Music is a native app for Windows, macOS and Linux. It opens in a moment, stays light on memory and looks like the rest of your computer.

home.name: Home
home.caption: Your mixes, new releases and picks for you, in a home page that is easy to browse.

player.name: Now playing
player.caption: A full player with the song's artwork, lyrics that keep time and your queue.

library.name: Library
library.caption: Playlists, albums, artists and uploads, sorted the way your account sorts them.

search.name: Search
search.caption: Songs, albums, artists and podcasts, with filters right under the search box.

downloads.name: Downloads
downloads.caption: Everything you saved for offline listening, ready even without a connection.

settings.name: Settings
settings.caption: Pick a color, tune how music plays and choose how songs blend into each other.

benchmarks.title: Not a web page in disguise.
benchmarks.description: Most desktop players for YouTube Music are web pages running inside a browser, some of them the YouTube Music website itself. HyperTube Music is a real app, so your computer does less work to play the same songs.
benchmarks.label: Choose what to compare

headline.memory: less memory than the next best
headline.cpu: less processor use than the next best
headline.startup: faster to open than the next best

own.memory: of memory while a song plays
own.cpu: of one processor core while a song plays
own.startup: to open, with the home page fully drawn

explain.memory: Memory used by all of the app's processes while a song plays.
explain.cpu: Average processor use, as a share of one core, while a song plays in the background.
explain.startup: Time from starting the app until its home page has finished drawing.

benchmarks.measured: Measured on {{date}} on one Linux laptop (Intel Core i7-11800H, 32 GB), signed out, playing the same song. Medians of repeated runs.

playground.title: Poke around before you install.
playground.description: A quick look at some of the app's features. Pick one, press play and try it out.
playground.label: Features
playground.credits: The songs are in the public domain (CC0) and come from ccMixter and the Internet Archive.

colors.title: Looks like it belongs
colors.description: The app picks up your desktop's accent color and follows light and dark mode. Prefer a color of your own? Pick one and the whole app changes with it.

transitions.title: Songs that flow together
transitions.description: Play without gaps, fade between songs, or let Smart transitions listen to each pair of songs and blend them at the right moment.

lyrics.title: Lyrics that keep time
lyrics.description: Sing along with lyrics that follow the song line by line. Click a line to jump straight to it.

offline.title: Your music, even offline
offline.description: Download songs, albums and playlists. When the connection drops, the app keeps playing what you saved.

equalizer.title: Sound the way you like it
equalizer.description: A ten band equalizer with presets, and a volume control that sounds even all the way from quiet to loud.

colors.title: Appearance
colors.followHint: Uses the accent color of your desktop

caption.off: One song ends, the next one starts. No gap in between.
caption.crossfade: The songs fade into each other over a few seconds.
caption.smart: Both songs share a tempo, so the app lines up their beats and mixes the next one in.
caption.smartFade: These songs have different beats, so the app blends them where the first one winds down.
caption.nothingNext: Nothing to play next. Download another song or stop pretending you are offline.

more.title: Everything you need, nothing you don't.

podcasts.title: Podcasts
podcasts.description: Pick up episodes where you left off, save them for later and change the playback speed.

videos.title: Music videos
videos.description: Switch a song to its music video right in the player, and back again.

live.title: Live stations
live.description: Tune in to live streams, clearly marked wherever they show up.

controls.title: Media keys and tray
controls.description: Control music from your keyboard, your system's media controls or the tray.

discord.title: Discord status
discord.description: Show what you are listening to on your Discord profile, if you want to.

privacy.title: Private by default
privacy.description: No tracking. Crash reports are off unless you turn them on.

languages.title: Your language
languages.description: Available in English, Russian and Ukrainian, with more to come.

openSource.title: Open source
openSource.description: Every line of code is public on GitHub, free to read and improve.

download.title: Ready when you are.
download.description: Free for Windows, macOS and Linux. Choose your system and start listening in a minute.
download.label: Choose your system
download.unavailable: There is no download for this system yet.

faq.title: Questions, answered.
faq.description: The things people ask most before trying HyperTube Music.
